summary: Taoping Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $3.195M convertible note offering to Streeterville Capital, LLC. The unsecured note bears 7% interest, matures in 12 months, and is convertible into up to 2,970,440 ordinary shares at a fixed $6.00/share conversion price, with a redemption feature allowing monthly conversions at 80% of the lowest 10-day VWAP subject to a $0.30 floor price. The offering relies on General Instruction I.B.5 of Form F-3, limited to one-third of non-affiliate market value ($4.723M). This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation.
